description: A company by company number, as on its Companies Daily card: company type, status, incorporation and dissolution dates, town, postcode district and region of the registered office, jurisdiction, SIC codes, last accounts and the next accounts and confirmation statement due (with overdue flags), charges and insolvency history flags, “What this means” notes (facts from the register, no judgement of the company’s health) and the classified filing history. No names of directors or people with significant control.

company_number.description: Companies House company number, e.g. "00445790" (leading zeros optional) or "SC123456".

name: get_company
title: Company card from the Companies House register
